name: beautifulrepo
description: Audit how a repository presents itself to readers, offline and read-only, using BeautifulRepo's checklists and tools.

interface.shortDescription: Audit a repository's README, trust files and links offline.
interface.longDescription: Run BeautifulRepo's offline checks and checklists against a local repository and get prioritized, evidence-backed findings about its README, license, contribution guide, links and first-success path. Read-only: nothing is written or sent anywhere.
